scope: Path admission, not correctness or performance certification
findings: Reviewed complete final diff against reviewed round-07 source; generic kernel, interpolation arithmetic, shape/scale dispatch and tile heuristic unchanged.
Removes packed integer output and dtype aliasing, restoring prior interleave stores and ordinary output allocation for all dtypes.
All nine exact-2x loads now clamp both row and column coordinates, including inactive tail lanes, into positive-dimension input plane bounds. Output tail stores remain masked.
All computation and memory movement remain Triton. Host only performs metadata decisions, allocation and kernel launch; no new external dependency or fallback.
Clamping can change compiler lowering and memory organization; comments about eliminating barriers are a hypothesis, not verified performance facts.
